theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_stab_lipschitz_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (w : Euclid P → ℝ), MeasurableSet M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ M → μHE[m] K ≠ ∞) → ContinuousOn w M → (∀ u : Euclid P, ContinuousOn (fun x => (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection u) M) → ((∀ (ζ : Euclid P → ℝ), LocallyLipschitzOn M ζ → ∀ j : Fin P, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => fderivWithin ℝ ζ M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) (μHE[m].restrict M)) ∧ ∀ (ζ : Euclid P → ℝ), LocallyLipschitzOn M ζ → (∃ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C ∧ C ⊆ M ∧ ∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ C → ζ x = 0) → ∃ (C' : Set (Euclid P)) (ζs : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ), IsCompact C' ∧ C' ⊆ M ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (ζs k) ∧ HasCompactSupport (ζs k)) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ C' → ζs k x = 0) ∧ TendstoUniformlyOn ζs ζ atTop M ∧ Tendsto (fun k => ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ j : Fin P, (fderiv ℝ (ζs k) x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) - fderivWithin ℝ ζ M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) ^ 2) ∂μHE[m]) atTop (𝓝 0)) → (∀ ζ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → (∃ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C ∧ C ⊆ M ∧ ∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ C → ζ x = 0) → ∫ x in M, w x * ζ x ^ 2 ∂μHE[m] ≤ ∫ x in M, ∑ j : Fin P, (fderiv ℝ ζ x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) ^ 2 ∂μHE[m]) → ∀ ζ : Euclid P → ℝ, LocallyLipschitzOn M ζ → (∃ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C ∧ C ⊆ M ∧ ∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ C → ζ x = 0) → ∫ x in M, w x * ζ x ^ 2 ∂μHE[m] ≤ ∫ x in M, ∑ j : Fin P, (fderivWithin ℝ ζ M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) ^ 2 ∂μHE[m]
